What happened to the Lizzie Borden house and can you stay there?

Fans of Netflix series could have a unique experience at Lizzie Borden's former abode

It is described as one of the country's most haunted homes.

The house where Lizzie Borden's father and stepmother were killed is still standing today and offers those interested a unique haunting experience. Netflix's new season of Monster has put the spotlight back on the killings of Andrew and Abby Borden.

Their daughter Lizzie was eventually put on trial and accused of their murder but never found guilty. The series, inspired by what happened, is still the most watched title among subscribers to the platform.

Dramatised scenes even show serial killer Aileen Wuornos visiting the Borden house herself years after the events depicted. While there is no evidence she actually made this trip, there is some truth as visitors can really visit the house today and even stay there. Here's all you need to know.

What happened to Lizzie Borden's House?

The house where Lizzie Borden leaved with her family until her father and stepmother's gruesome death is very much still standing. It can be found in the city of Fall River, in the state of Massachusetts.

Once more, it's true that you can spend the night there. The residence has operated as a bed and breakfast since around 1996 ever since the couple who owned it at the time inherited it from their grandparents.

Back then, they claimed that the room that Abby Borden's body was discovered in was the most requested room by guests. The local area have seemingly supportive of its operation, with The Fall River Historical Society helping to promote it as a tourist attraction.
